lines.text: Many learners say: I have not eat lunch yet.
Better: I have not eaten lunch yet.
Eaten! I have not eaten lunch yet.

data.wrong: I have not eat lunch yet.
data.right: I have not eaten lunch yet.

native.tip: Dalam bahasa Indonesia “belum makan” tidak mengubah kata kerja, tapi bahasa Inggris pakai have not eaten.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I have not eat lunch yet.” 😅 Untuk “belum makan”, pakai bentuk eaten: “I have not eaten lunch yet.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “eaten”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I have not eaten lunch yet.” Lalu tulis satu kalimat lain, misalnya: “I have not done my homework yet.” Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: In Indonesian “belum makan” does not change the verb, but English uses have not eaten.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I have not eat lunch yet.” 😅 For “belum makan”, use the form eaten: “I have not eaten lunch yet.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
